# `perception`

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="s-perception-occlusion"></span>`perception.occlusion` | string | | | `centre-line`, `outline` | advanced | :material-check-circle:{ title="Active" } `wired` | How a road user is hidden from a sensor: `centre-line` (the line to its reference point; other vehicles are discs half a body width across) or `outline` (seen when any corner of its outline is in view with a clear line; other vehicles are their oriented body rectangles; the visible-corner rule of Günther et al., IEEE VNC 2016). |

## Choices

The labelled values of every closed or model setting above.

??? note "`perception.occlusion`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `centre-line` | Centre line | The line to the reference point; other vehicles are discs. |
 | `outline` | Outline | Any visible outline corner; other vehicles are oriented rectangles. |

??? note "`perception.vehicle[].kind`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `radar` | Radar | A radar (CPM `SensorType` 1). |
 | `camera` | Camera | A mono camera (CPM `SensorType` 3). |
 | `lidar` | Lidar | A lidar (CPM `SensorType` 2). |

??? note "`perception.vehicle[].mount`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `front` | Front | The front bumper. |
 | `rear` | Rear | The rear bumper. |
 | `centre` | Centre | The body's centre. |
